Usage: gaia search lkm references [OPTIONS]

 Look up paper references and cited-by lists.

 POST /papers/reference.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server                           TEXT  Configured LKM index id.    │
│                                                  [default: bohrium]          │
│ --paper-id                                 TEXT  LKM paper id (repeatable,   │
│                                                  numeric; a `paper:` prefix  │
│                                                  is stripped). Combined with │
│                                                  --doi, at most 20 seeds.    │
│ --doi                                      TEXT  Paper DOI (repeatable).     │
│                                                  Combined with --paper-id,   │
│                                                  at most 20 seeds.           │
│ --with-abstract     --no-with-abstract           Include abstracts on the    │
│                                                  seed and both neighbor      │
│                                                  lists.                      │
│                                                  [default: with-abstract]    │
│ --with-reference    --no-with-reference          Return forward references.  │
│                                                  [default:                   │
│                                                  no-with-reference]          │
│ --with-cited-by     --no-with-cited-by           Return reverse cited-by     │
│                                                  lists.                      │
│                                                  [default: with-cited-by]    │
│ --out                                      PATH  Write JSON to PATH (atomic) │
│                                                  instead of stdout.          │
│ --no-hint                                        Suppress Gaia follow-up     │
│                                                  suggestions on stderr.      │
│ --help                                           Show this message and exit. │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia search lkm references --paper-id <paper_id>
 gaia search lkm references --doi 10.1234/example --with-reference
 What you have:
 a paper ID or DOI, cited-by list  ->  references (default)
 a paper ID or DOI, forward refs   ->  --with-reference
 the extracted knowledge graph     ->  package
 a title or package id             ->  not this command
 Use this when you already know paper ids or DOIs and want bibliographic
 forward references and/or reverse cited-by lists. This is a paper-card lookup,
 not a knowledge graph; use `package` for the extracted LKM paper graph. Do not
 pass a title or package id.
 At least one of --paper-id / --doi is required (repeatable). Combined seeds
 are capped at 20 before dedupe. A `paper:` prefix on --paper-id is stripped.
 Defaults match the HTTP API and are always sent: --with-abstract,
 --no-with-reference, --with-cited-by. The response uses `data.papers`. An
 empty paper id means LKM has not covered that record.
 Search and lookup calls cost 0.05 CNY each, covered first by LKM's personal
 monthly 1,000-call quota.
 API: POST /papers/reference
 Endpoint links: gaia search lkm docs
